name: nourish
description: Root orchestration for the Nourish monorepo (mobile + backend). See README.md.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend/functions && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,mobile -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend/functions run serve" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.seed: npm --prefix backend/functions run build && cross-env FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8090 GCLOUD_PROJECT=nourish-22776 node backend/functions/lib/scripts/seed.js
scripts.images:upload: npm --prefix backend/functions run build && cross-env STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9199 GCLOUD_PROJECT=nourish-22776 node backend/functions/lib/scripts/upload-recipe-images.js
